query: How many people are there in the world?

results.title: World Population Clock: 8.3 Billion People (LIVE, 2026) - Worldometer
results.content:
In 1970, there were roughly half as many people in the world as there are now.
The current world population is 8,305,224,076 as of Saturday, July 25, 2026 according to the most recent United Nations estimates elaborated by Worldometer.

results.title: World Population Clock: 8.3 Billion People (LIVE, August 2026)
results.content:
The total world population as of 2026 stands at approximately 8,283,851,939, with an annual growth rate of 0.825%.
Currently, 58.5% of the world's population is urban, representing approximately 4.853 billion people in 2026.
India is the most populous country in 2026, with over 1.64 billion people.
